name: ENPRO
recent: Enproserve 在 2026 年 9 月获得 Perbadanan Putrajaya 价值约 RM12.3 million 的设施管理合约。10 月底至 11 月中，集团董事经理 Azman bin Yusof 及 299 Global Sdn Bhd 在闭市期内外多次申报增持股份。同期公司也公告了主要管理人员变动及注册地址变更。
notable: 获得 Perbadanan Putrajaya 价值约 RM12.3 million 的设施管理合约。
集团董事经理 Azman bin Yusof 及 299 Global Sdn Bhd 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次增持公司股份。
公司公告主要管理人员变动，Hakimi bin Bahador 卸任主要管理人员职务。
risks: 董事经理 Azman bin Yusof 在闭市期内多次进行股份交易，相关交易已按上市条例申报。
公司于 10 月底公告主要管理人员变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM50.16 million，环比增长 79.8%，同比增长 20.7%；净利为 RM0.997 million，同比减少 24.8%，净利率为 2.0%，上一季度净利率为 -5.8%。

recent_en: In September 2026, Enproserve secured a facility management contract from Perbadanan Putrajaya worth about RM12.3 million. From late October to mid-November, Group Managing Director Azman bin Yusof and 299 Global Sdn Bhd filed multiple notices of share acquisitions during and outside the closed period. The company also announced a change in principal officer and a change of registered address.
notable_en: Secured a facility management contract from Perbadanan Putrajaya worth about RM12.3 million.
Group Managing Director Azman bin Yusof and 299 Global Sdn Bhd acquired shares multiple times from late October to mid-November.
Announced a change in principal officer, with Hakimi bin Bahador ceasing to be a principal officer.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Azman bin Yusof conducted multiple share dealings during the closed period, which were announced under the listing requirements.
The company announced a change in principal officer in late October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM50.16 million, up 79.8% QoQ and 20.7% YoY; net income was RM0.997 million, down 24.8% YoY, with a net margin of 2.0% versus -5.8% in the previous quarter.
